data.title: ‘September altcoin season is over’ — What’s next for altcoins?
data.description:
According to on-chain analyst Joao Wedson, the Altcoin Season Index has hit an overheated zone, and Bitcoin may strengthen from now going forward. 

The altcoin season we experienced in September is already over! Now is no longer an ideal time for altcoins, as the Altcoin Season Index has peaked.

He added that ASI indicator peaks tend to coincide with liquidity rotation back to Bitcoin and stablecoins. 

According to him, this is why several altcoins have seen much sharper declines compared to Bitcoin.

Since 2nd October, BTC’s price has dropped by 8% from $87K. It briefly tagged $80K, before rebounding on the charts. Over the same period, Ethereum [ETH] shed 14% of its value and slipped below $2.5K from $2.8K. 

XRP crashed by 20% while Solana [SOL] lost 15% of its value. In fact, most of the altcoins saw double and triple gains in Q3. So, the intense profit-taking during slight BTC corrections was not surprising. 

Interestingly, CryptoQuant data revealed that the level of profit-taking in the altcoins segment hit a 1-year high. This was illustrated by the Altcoins Exchange Inflow, with the same hitting record levels seen in last October’s market crash. 

However, it was not all that gloomy for bulls positioning for potential opportunities in the sector. 

Are other waves of altcoin rallies likely?

As mentioned by Wedson, such an altcoin sell-off triggers capital rotation to Bitcoin and stablecoins. Put differently, parked stablecoins would increase as traders wait for better conditions to jump back in. 

As the most dominant stablecoin in the crypto market, Tether’s USDT market share can help track both the said liquidity rotation and inflection points for altcoin rallies. 

There has been a small uptick in USDT market dominance this week (green candle), suggesting that stablecoins were parked as profit-taking intensified. As expected, the altcoin market cooled off a bit, as shown in the chart. 

However, the broader trend in USDT dominance decline suggested that the altcoin season rallies may not be over, just paused or in a cool-off. 

During the early innings of the 2023 bull run, USDT dominance dropped from 8% to 6%. It declined to 3.7% in 2024. During the downtrend, the altcoin market cap, excluding BTC and ETH, increased from $400B to over $1T. 

As such, a surge in USDT dominance could delay another altcoin rally. However if USDT dominance follows the 2023 pattern, the altcoin market could be set for a major rally next year. 

For analyst Aaron Disher, there is even a likely short-term recovery for the altcoin rally. 

I think the crypto fiesta can continue this weekend because smaller altcoins are already showing strength while Bitcoin consolidates.

Final Summary

  • Q3’s altcoin season peaked as profit-taking hit a 12-month high.
  • BTC price consolidation could trigger a short-term altcoin market rebound.

data.title: Polkadot price rebounds 11% – Can DOT extend its rally to $1.75?
data.description:
Polkadot [DOT] has extended its bullish recovery by recording a 10.93% to $1.27 over the last 24 hours. The move comes just two days after the token price action rebounded from key EMA support at around $1.02.

Interestingly, the bullish advances follow a 54% reduction in annual token issuance and the launch of a native stablecoin, two developments that could strengthen the network’s long-term outlook.

At the same time, the network’s increasing Open Interest (OI) and a growing preference for leveraged long positions also point to increased trader participation. Could the token’s sustained buying pressure turn these developments into a lasting DOT recovery?

Tokenomics changes strengthen Polkadot’s outlook

The reduction in annual token issuance marks a significant shift in Polkadot’s tokenomics. Fewer new tokens entering circulation equates to reduced selling pressure. Its circulating supply currently ranks 36th among the L1 tokens.

Meanwhile, the launch of a native stablecoin could expand activity across the ecosystem. Stablecoins support payments, decentralized finance (DeFi) applications, and liquidity, potentially creating new use cases for Polkadot.

Together, these developments offer investors additional reasons to reassess DOT’s prospects after its prolonged price weakness.

Derivatives data reveals a strong preference for longs

Zooming down to the Polkadot’s derivative data, its OI has also increased 15% to $78 million as of writing, suggesting traders are opening new positions as the token advances.

Notably, long accounts now represent 73% of total leveraged positions, according to the recent Polkadot’s Long/Short data, suggesting that most traders and investors are betting on further gains for the token.

Can DOT sustain its recovery above $1.27?

On the daily chart, DOT has rebounded from support near $1.02 to reach $1.27, marking a notable improvement in its short-term structure. Besides, the token is now trading above all its key EMA support, pointing to potential buyer dominance continuation in the short run.

Holding above reclaimed support could strengthen the case for further gains, while renewed selling could expose the token to another test of lower levels.

All in all, Polkadot’s issuance reduction, stablecoin launch, and increased derivatives activity provide potential catalysts for continued price appreciation to $1.75.

Final Summary

  • DOT prices have jumped by 10.93% to $1.27, extending its two-day recovery from EMA support near $1.02.
  • The recent network upgrade paired with surging open interests and buyer dominance, points to a continuation rally.

data.title: Ethereum’s $177M long squeeze sparks concerns – Can ETH hold above $2.1K?
data.description:
Extreme bullish positioning in the derivatives market can cut both ways.

Notably, Ethereum’s [ETH] current market structure is a good example. According to the data from CoinGlass, over $177 million in ETH long positions were liquidated on the 8th of October, which marked the largest long squeeze since early June.

With this in mind, ETH’s derivatives market may be set up for another squeeze. Lookonchain recently highlighted that smart trader, with a reported 100% win rate and $9.26 million in total profits, is back in action. After the market dip, the trader opened a 20x leveraged long position on 12,000 ETH worth $29.88 million. The position is now sitting on an unrealized profit of $626,000.

The key takeaway? Other traders are leaning bullish too.

Bitfinex whales’ ETH long positions are rising, while the Ethereum Long/Short Ratio crossed above 1 for the first time after three days of negative readings. This points to a shift toward bullish positioning. However, if too many traders crowd into long, another sharp move lower could trigger a fresh wave of liquidations.

From a technical lens, with Ethereum [ETH] down 8% this week, the violent bullish positioning may lead to another bull trap, potentially pushing the price toward $2.1k if support breaks. But does this aggressive long positioning mean that traders are anticipating a catalyst that the broader market has yet to price in?

Ethereum: Hidden catalyst or crowded trade?

Ethereum’s recent weakness may not be ETH-specific, as altcoin rotation could be behind the sell-off too.

Technically speaking, ETH is down almost 8% in the week, while Solana [SOL] has corrected by over 9%. Moreover, Bitcoin dominance has climbed back above 60%, putting pressure on the altcoins. However, if BTC.D fails to break through this resistance again; it could clear the path for an altcoin recovery, which may explain why traders are still building bullish Ethereum positions.

On the supply side note, Binance’s ETH reserves have reduced from nearly 4 million to below 3.5 million, thus recording a 6-month low. The drop in the ETH reserves on Binance may add to upward pressure on the price if Bitcoin dominance fails to rise and capital rotation begins to take place back into altcoins. 

Given this setup, Ethereum’s bullish positioning could be more than a fluke.

On-chain liquidity across Ethereum also remains strong. According to Token Terminal, Ethereum added $243.4 million in stablecoin market cap over the last seven days, leading all networks. This could encourage fresh buying activity, particularly with ETH reserves on exchanges continuing to deplete, which could reduce selling pressure, giving bulls more breathing room to rally prices.

This makes the current setup different from the previous extended squeeze. If capital continues to flow into ETH, a breakout in the ETH/BTC pair could serve as the next catalyst for upside. This indicates that traders are positioning ahead of a potential shift in momentum that the broader market has yet to price in.

Final Summary

  • Rising ETH longs increase liquidation risks, but falling exchange reserves could support a recovery.
  • Growing stablecoin liquidity and a possible drop in Bitcoin dominance could boost ETH if capital flows back into altcoins.

data.title: Uniswap trader transfers $13M in UNI as losses hit $3M — Sign of more downside?
data.description:
Since falling to a low of $7.00, Uniswap has exhibited upside momentum on the charts, closing at higher highs for two consecutive days.

In doing so, the altcoin rose to a local high of $7.54 before a slight slip. At the time of writing, Uniswap was trading at around $7.52 after rising slightly by 1.26%.

However, trading volume continued to decline, dropping by 47%. This hinted at reduced market activity as investors waited for a clear market direction across the board. 

Uniswap whale transfers $13.18 million in UNI

With Uniswap on its back foot, some whales may be choosing to exit too. According to Lookonchain, for instance, a trader withdrew 1.79 million UNI, worth $13.18 million, from Venus Protocol and deposited it on Binance.

The trader bought UNI a year ago at an average price of $9. After the recent rally, these holdings saw significant gains. 

However, following the latest trend reversal, the trader’s holdings were sitting at a loss at press time. If sold at the press time levels, he would realize approximately $3 million in losses. 

The trader’s decision to make such a transfer could allude to a lack of confidence in the market. However, the transfer alone is not a confirmation that a sale occurred. 

Typically, selling by large holders increases the available supply and can add further downside pressure.

Is the pressure cooling down?

Despite the potential selling pressure from the trader, other investors, particularly in the spot market, appeared to have a different view of the market.

While Uniswap traded below $8, traders continued to accumulate the altcoin. According to CryptoQuant’s Exchange Netflow data, the metric remained negative for three consecutive days and continued to fall. 

Over the past day, for example, the altcoin’s Exchange Netflow fell to a low of -624K. The declining Netflow suggested that more assets have recently left exchanges.  

Spot Taker CVD further seemed to support this observation. The altcoin’s Taker CVD remained positive over the past week, suggesting that buyers extended their dominance. 

Typically, sustained spot buying can absorb some of the selling pressure and help prevent further price declines.

What’s next for UNI?

Although some buying activity has returned, the renewed demand has not been strong enough to trigger a trend reversal.

At the time of writing, the market was still leaning bearish. For instance, Uniswap’s Relative Strength Index (RSI) remained in bearish territory at 46.

At the same time, UNI traded below the 20-day EMA and was testing the 50-day EMA. Holding below the short-term MA could hint at the prevailing pressure, but the 50-day EMA could sit as a strong support. 

The prevailing market conditions suggested that demand remains insufficient to trigger a notable rebound. This leaves the altcoin at a risk of further price drop or extended consolidation.

Having said that, Uniswap is likely to hover between $7.1 and $7.5. On the other side, if demand strengthens enough, the altcoin could reclaim $8 and target $8.2.

Final summary

  • A trader withdrew 1.79 million UNI, worth $13.18 million, from Venus Protocol and then deposited it on Binance.
  • Uniswap [UNI] rose slightly to $7.5, but the market momentum is still leaning bearish.

data.title: Basic Attention Token rallies 20% as BAT’s trend turns bullish – What’s next?
data.description:
Basic Attention Token [BAT] has rallied 19.8% in the past 24 hours and has surpassed the $0.127 high posted in May. The altcoin’s long-term trend was beginning to shift bullishly, though it was still 42.3% lower than the 2026 high at $0.2376 made in January.

The Open Interest behind BAT perpetuals has surged by 60% in the past 24 hours as of writing. CoinMarketCap data showed a daily trading volume increase of 456% at the time of writing.

It was a good sign of strong short-term bullish intent. The rising spot CVD highlighted spot demand, and rising speculative interest underlined that market participants were willing to buy a strong altcoin.

The long-term Basic Attention Token trend was also taking a turn for the better.

BAT achieves a bullish swing structure shift

On the 1-day timeframe, the rally from the August low at $0.0552 has been remarkable so far. The trading volume has steadily increased in recent weeks too, helping push the Accumulation/Distribution indicator higher.

The upward momentum and steady demand propelled prices past the $0.127 swing high to shift the swing structure bullishly. The $0.10 psychological round-number resistance, which had been a supply zone in June, was smashed aside.

This was an encouraging sight for long-term investors. They can now wait for a pullback to buy the altcoin, anticipating the uptrend to continue.

These long-term holders might have to wait a few weeks or even months for BAT to pull back into a zone of interest to buy. As things stand, this area of interest is at and below $0.10.

If BAT prices continue to go higher, the zone of interest will change.

Should BAT traders wait for a consolidation phase?

The price was currently testing the $0.139 high from February. The H4 Awesome Oscillator reading was at highs not seen since December 2025, which made a good argument that the market might be overextended.

Automatically looking to go short, anticipating a crowded long trade, could be a mistake. Altcoins that pump like this can easily keep the run going longer than expected.

It would be better for swing traders to wait for BAT to settle into a consolidation before looking to buy. Ideally, such a consolidation follows a correction toward $0.115-$0.118.

Final Summary

  • Basic Attention Token has benefited from the rising altcoin enthusiasm in recent weeks and succeeded in establishing a bullish daily swing structure.
  • Long-term investors can wait for a price drop toward $0.10 or lower to look for an ideal buying opportunity to ride the trend upward.

data.title: ‘Self-custody will die very quickly’ – Ledger wallet theft hits $91M
data.description:
Ledger theft has hit $91 million, spanning nearly 500 addresses, and raises questions about the future of crypto self-custody. 

The Tron network is the hardest hit, with 276 victim addresses drained of about $64.5 million. The Bitcoin [BTC] addresses are the second most affected (276 addresses), losing $17.7 million, while the Ethereum [ETH] ecosystem suffered $8.8 million across 55 addresses. 

Because the impact on BNB Chain, Base, Avalanche, and other chains hasn’t been fully traced, Galaxy’s head of research, Alex Thorn, viewed the $91 million as a “floor” of total theft. Simply put, the figure could rise after Ledger completes a full audit in the coming days. 

Ledger attacker begins laundering funds

As of the 9th of October, about $73 million of the stolen funds sits in attacker-controlled wallets across Bitcoin, Ethereum [ETH], and Tron [TRX]. $3 million has been moved into Tornado Cash and other relay accounts. 

Some stolen USDT has been converted to USDD ($13.65 million). Surprisingly, the attacker has also moved some funds to Binance as security analysts press the exchange to freeze them. 

Both Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) and the current CEO Richard Teng vowed to help whenever the need arises to recover the funds. In particular, Teng said, 

As investigations continue, the focus must be on supporting affected users, tracing funds, and assisting recovery efforts wherever possible. Security is a shared responsibility, and Binance stands ready to support the industry’s collective efforts.

It remains to be seen how much will be recovered from this pledged coordinated approach. The industry is still reeling from the $114 million Coldcard hardware exploit in Q3. So, how did the Ledger attack happen, and how was it missed? 

Did CryptoBillis compromise Ledger users?

Preliminary reports point to a supply attack that affected Ledger Nano X and Ledger Nano S Plus hardware wallets from Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis. 

According to unverified reports, this was a localized hardware tampering operation. The two models above were allegedly compromised and had spyware components that could read and send seed phrases to a server. 

Seed phrases are like passwords to crypto wallets. This meant the attacker could drain the funds in these devices if they aren’t in a multi-sig setup. 

Following these allegations, users pressed Arravind Prabu, the CEO of CryptoBillis, for answers. Strangely, Prabu defended himself by saying that he is no longer part of CryptoBillis. 

When asked why he didn’t publicly disclose the sale of the reseller firm, he said that they signed an NDA (non-disclosure agreement) with the Chinese buyer. The NDA would conveniently expire on October 19th, right after the attack. 

Reacting to the saga, Ark Invest’s head of crypto research, Lorenzo Valente, noted, 

This is a pretty wild story if confirmed, and highlights two things: Never buy from a reseller, even if official. Self-custody will die very quickly if nothing is done

Final Summary

  • Ledger supply chain attack has hit $91 million in losses, affecting over 470 addresses.
  • Experts warn the increasing hardware wallet exploits could kill crypto self-custody.

data.title: All about NEAR’s latest rebound and the odds of a new price reversal
data.description:
At the time of writing, Near Protocol’s native token NEAR was attempting to recover after a sharp sell-off that erased more than 10% of its value in just 24 hours.

Despite the correction, however, the token has shown encouraging signs of strength on lower timeframes. On the hourly chart, for instance, the altcoin’s price action reacted positively after hitting the $4.10–$4.70 demand zone. This has allowed buyers to reclaim short-term momentum and shift the immediate market structure in their favor.

In fact, the rebound has renewed optimism among network bulls who are now targeting the most recent swing high at $5.6. Hence, the question: Will the momentum materialise or will sellers have their say?

Let’s dig deeper and see…

An aggressive return from retail traders?

A look at derivatives data revealed a sharp hike in retail participation. A growing number of smaller buy orders have been entering the market around press time price levels. This suggested that retail traders probably view the recent correction as a buying opportunity.

This influx of buyers has helped stabilize price action and improve short-term sentiment.

However, it’s still worth noting that retail-driven rallies can also become vulnerable if momentum fades or larger market participants begin to take profits.

Volume bubble maps signal rising volatility

While buying activity has increased, volume data also hinted at elevated trading activity. According to the network’s Volume Bubble Maps data, both the Spot and Futures markets have been experiencing overheated trading conditions.

In the past, such spikes in activity have often preceded significant price swings as liquidity built up and traders competed for positioning. The same turn of events could be in store for NEAR.

Can NEAR reverse and target the next resistance at $5.6?

On the daily chart, the $4.10–$4.70 demand zone remains the key support area for bulls.

If buyers continue to defend this region and absorb selling pressure, NEAR could build enough momentum for a broader recovery. On the other hand, failure to hold the demand zone could invite another wave of selling and extend the altcoin’s recent correction.

Finally, it’s worth pointing out that network bulls have been making their presence felt as the altcoin’s price action gathered some momentum on the hourly chart.

The unmitigated liquidity cluster worth $48.12 million lying at the $5.6-resistance level highlighted it as a high probability target for the Near Protocol’s bulls.

Final Summary

  • NEAR fell by more than 10% in the last 24 hours before stabilizing within the $4.10–$4.70 demand zone.
  • Network’s retail participation surged as trading activity overheated across both Spot and Futures markets.

data.title: CFTC Chairman claims ‘we will go to war with the statute we’ve got’ as CLARITY Act fails
data.description:
The CLARITY Act’s failure to pass the Senate has disappointed the crypto market a lot and killed the hopes of many looking forward to the bill’s passage.

In this list of disappointed groups and individuals, the U.S Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has disclosed that they do not want to wait any longer for Congress to pass comprehensive crypto legislation before establishing rules for the cryptocurrency market.

According to CFTC Chairman Mike Selig,

We would have preferred to have a federal regulatory framework codified into statute, but we go to war with the statute we’ve got and we’ve got clear authority and we’re going to use it.

What’s the CFTC’s game plan?

The CFTC intends to use its existing powers to establish basic rules and provide greater clarity for crypto businesses and market participants.

At the same time, Selig also expressed hope that Congress will revisit the CLARITY Act in the future, potentially refining its provisions to address remaining regulatory gaps.

Faryar Shirzad, Chief Policy Officer at Coinbase, argued that the proposed CLARITY Act would have helped the CFTC strengthen its ability to regulate crypto markets by providing additional funding mechanisms and faster hiring authority.

However, he believes that Congress should provide practical support, including the resources and staff needed to enforce rules effectively. This, rather than simply requesting another report on the agency’s challenges.

Tension remains but…

Needless to say, despite multiple temporary fixes, the frustration is still felt among many Republicans.

This was particularly underscored by Senator Cynthia Lummis, who claimed that Democrats opposed the CLARITY Act despite its desire for a new rule. For those unaware, the Democrats have demanded that digital commodity exchanges should provide customers with clear disclosures about consumer protections.

Lummis noted,

We added it to the Clarity Act, and Senate Democrats voted no.

In fact, the delay was also felt in Polymarket’s odds, with the same down to 5% at press time. No matter the uncertainty, however, the CFTC is not stopping.

Just recently, the CFTC updated its FAQs to clarify how tokenization and blockchain technology can operate within existing regulations. The agency also allowed regulated firms to use blockchain for record keeping, provided records remain authentic, accessible, and reliable.

Final Summary

  • Mike Selig is hopeful that Congress will revisit the CLARITY Act in the future.
  • Senator Lummis claimed that Democrats opposed the CLARITY Act despite its desire for a new rule.

data.title: Assessing whether ONDO crypto could reclaim $0.50 despite $4.4M whale sale
data.description:
The crypto market has witnessed massive selling pressure over the past three days. Amid this intense downside pressure, some long-term Ondo [ONDO] whales are capitulating and exiting the market.

A whale offloads ONDO worth $4.4M

According to on-chain monitor Nazoku, a long-term ONDO investor, mcaavebank.eth, sold 9 million ONDO worth $4.4 million.

The sale was executed after five months of providing liquidity on Uniswap. The investor’s decision to exit during a downward trend reflected fear. 

Notably, the exchange flows also reflect this sell-side activity. ONDO’s Spot Netflow turned positive after being negative for four consecutive days. 

On the 9th of  October, Spot Netflow rose to $810k, reversing from the -$6 million recorded on the previous day, indicating that more funds flowed into exchanges.

Private markets offer a lifeline

Interestingly, while the broader market mostly declined, ONDO was an exception. After falling to $0.43, the altcoin rebounded, closing at $0.47 on the 8th of October.

On the next day, ONDO showed relative strength, rising to a daily high of $0.49, thus defying the broader bearish trend.

The altcoin extended its bullish trend after Ondo Finance launched its 24/7 Private Markets. Ondo Private Markets offers tokenized exposure to private companies before they go public. Ondo Finance stated that these markets seek to address the existing gap between retail and institutional investors.

Most importantly, these funds offer investors access to companies across various sectors. Such firms include AI, robotics, cybersecurity, biotech, infrastructure, and more.

This narrative appears to have supported the altcoin’s price action over the past day and may have helped the altcoin avoid the recent sell-off.

What ONDO’s momentum indicators say

Although the altcoin made some gains, with buyers making modest purchases, the broader trend showed bearish bias.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI), for example, rose to 56, but remained below the RSI-based MA as of writing. This setup suggested that the buying response was not enough to confirm a trend reversal, while sellers may still have the upper hand.

The True Strength Index (TSI) also supports this view, having fallen to 15. A falling TSI, alongside an RSI that remains below its RSI-based MA, indicated a weak upside momentum.

Under these circumstances, a bullish shift in momentum would help confirm a potential trend reversal. If buying pressure strengthens, ONDO could reclaim $0.50 and target $0.53.

However, given the broader downward bias, if the recent buying response fails to reverse the trend, ONDO could drop to $0.42.

Final summary

  • A  long-term ONDO investor, mcaavebank.eth, sold 9 million ONDO worth $4.4 million after offering liquidity on Uniswap for 5 months
  • The altcoin rebounded from a $0.43 slip as Ondo Finance launched its private markets, offering exposure to retail investors to private companies.

data.title: Pi crypto price prediction: Can OUSD plans help PI hold $0.08?
data.description:
Pi Network has outlined how stablecoins could eventually fit into its ecosystem, while revealing an exploratory partnership with Open Standard, the company behind OUSD.

PI traded around $0.081 after gaining 2.4% in the last 24 hours. But the project has not launched OUSD integration, and the latest announcement included no timetable on when or how it will do so.

Pi Network gives stablecoins a supporting role

In its announcement, Pi Network said stablecoins could make certain payments and settlements easier because they have values that are predictable.

The fact that their values are predictable could prove useful to merchants, accountants, and outside businesses that might not want to accept an asset whose price can change quickly.

Not that stablecoins should displace its native asset, but what the team wants is for stablecoins to only serve as an additional payment option.

Pi has partnered with Open Standard to look at possible rewards for Pioneers and how else OUSD can be used.

The wording also shows that Pi is still looking at what the partnership could produce, and it has not confirmed that OUSD is available on the network. Also, it hasn’t announced when an integration might happen.

Details about rewards, eligibility, and the technical setup are also not available yet.

PI faces an immediate test at $0.08

The PI price response was positive but measured. Its price moved up from a daily low near the $0.0792 price level to above $0.08, reaching about $0.0814 at the time of this writing.

Trading activity showed that daily volume fell by over 55% to about $4.3 million. The fall suggests that the price increase did not lead to a rush of new buyers.

For now, $0.08 is the level to watch. This is because if it remains above this level, it could allow it to make another attempt at the $0.082 price area. This is key because this is an area where the recent move lost momentum.

But a fall below it would place the daily low near the $0.0792 price area back in focus. That doesn’t mean the recovery will end, but it would show that buyers were struggling to defend the gain in the first place.

The announcement gives Pi a clearer direction when it comes to stablecoins. But whether it provides lasting support for PI will depend on what the partnership eventually delivers.

Final Summary

  • Pi Network is exploring OUSD-related rewards and utility, but no integration has happened.
  • PI must hold the $0.08 level before a stronger move toward the $0.082 price level becomes more convincing.
